Perplexity's agent harness (Computer) now supports Agent Plugins. This lets you operate at an abstraction level above individual connectors to app bundles and their corresponding skills.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Computer (@AskPerplexity); megjelent: 2026-11-03T20:23:02+00:00; link: https://x.com/AskPerplexity/status/2117714189674586114; média: videó, 132 másodperc]
Computer now supports Agent Plugins, packaging app connections and skills to get work done.

Browse plugins or bring your own by importing from GitHub or a .zip file, compatible across other agents.

Try it: https://perplexity.ai/computer/plugins
